summary: ECARX Holdings Inc. furnished a Form 6-K announcing a binding memorandum of business cooperation with TPK Holding Co., Ltd. to co-develop the ORCA LiDAR platform for global markets. The agreement involves joint system design and ECARX leading system integration and commercialization, with TPK contributing optical manufacturing. Mass production is expected in 2028 at TPK's Thailand facility. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisors were mentioned. This is a routine business partnership disclosure, not a special situation; no acquisition, divestiture, or structural event occurs.
